name: – After § 1 – Am 6
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text: 1d. Condemns the re-inclusion of Cuba on the United States list of State Sponsors of Terrorism as a politically motivated designation lacking credible justification; calls for its immediate removal from that list; stresses that this measure has severe extraterritorial consequences, further worsening Cuba’s access to the international banking system, humanitarian supplies and medicines;
